reason: I'll start with the cut, since the skin and vessel need a break before the platelet plug can seal it.
expectation: I expect the rough edge to damage the skin and a small vessel, leaving a place for platelets to gather.

alternatives.reason: The label explains that enzymes help form reinforcing threads, but I'd rather make the break first.

effect: The cut reaches a leaking blood vessel, so there is now a place to form the plug.
reaction: The narrowed vessel still leaking makes the need for a plug clear.
reason: I'll add the platelets to the cut to start sealing the leak.
expectation: I expect the platelets to gather at the damaged vessel and form a plug, though it may still need reinforcing.

alternatives.reason: The enzymes can make reinforcing threads, but I want to form the plug first.

effect: The platelet plug slows the leak, but the surface cut remains open and the plug still needs reinforcement.
reaction: It's clear how the platelets help, even though they haven't closed the whole cut.
reason: The enzyme label says it helps clotting proteins form threads, and this is the only available combination.
expectation: I expect the proteins to form threads that can reinforce the plug, though they may need another step to reach it.

effect: The proteins now form a mesh near the break, ready to reinforce the platelet plug.
reaction: The branching mesh makes the reinforcement easy to picture.
reason: I'll combine the threads with the plug to stop the bleeding; it's the only available combination.
expectation: I expect the mesh to strengthen the platelet plug and stop the leak.

effect: The mesh reinforced the platelet plug and stopped the bleeding, but the skin still needs to heal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the leak stop without the game pretending the whole cut had healed.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the threads to the plug showed how the two parts work together to stop bleeding.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the threads was a little predictable because the enzyme label explained the pairing and it was the only available combination.

surprise.text: The clot stopped the bleeding while the skin above it stayed open; stopping a leak is only the first repair.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though I followed the enzyme label rather than knowing how the enzymes make threads.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the skin heals after the bleeding stops. The open cut gives me a clear reason to find out what happens next.
